claims.statement: The Allen and McCoole fight was agreed to take place within fifty miles of St. Louis on 15 May 1869, with the winner to take the stakes and excursion money.
claims.excerpt: the fight is to come ot within fifty miles of St. Louis, on the 15th prox.
places: within fifty miles of St. Louis

fights.place: within fifty miles of St. Louis
fights.excerpt: the fight is to come ot within fifty miles of St. Louis, on the 15th prox.
fights.notes: Agreed match under the published articles; not yet fought in this article. 'Prox.' read as the next month.

notes: The training at Doyle's Exchange is McCoole's, not Allen's.
